Name: Land Icon
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
**Icons of the Land, Sea & Sky**

Icons of the different terrestrial modes are also known as Greater Icons, and are mostly Large beasts that reside in the terrain of their choosing. They wander the planar wilderness, revered by those who see them and left mostly in peace. Those who find kinship with these creatures often find them protecting their land and families. Agents of the Eidolons have been known to approach these icons and request their service as companions in battle or as mounts.

***Attack Methods.*** The stat block for these icons lists several attack options assuming the icon takes the form of an animal resembling a lion (land), small whale/shark (sea) or large bird (sky), but it may have various different methods of attack, including Bite, Gore, Slam, Hoof, etc. Depending on their form they may not have all of these attack options. You can change the attacks used as part of their multiattack if you wish to, changing the damage types to suit the method of attack you may want.

traits.name: Batter
traits.description: If the icon hits a creature with both of its claw attacks on the same turn, its target (if they are Large or smaller) is knocked prone.

traits.name: Telempathetic Discouragement
traits.description: When a creature targets the icon with an attack or effect intended to cause harm to it while within range of its telepathy, the attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. A creature charmed this way shares the icon’s feelings, becoming discouraged from violence and (though the icon holds no direct sway over their actions) they must contend with their guilt before further harming it. A creature that fails can repeat the saving throw at the start of each of their turns and each time they take damage, ending the effect on a successful save. A creature that succeeds any save against this effect becomes immune to it and the Telempathetic Discouragement of any icon with a CR of 7 or lower for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The icon makes a Bite attack and two Claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 4) piercing damage plus 6 (1d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Radiant Outpouring (Recharge 6)
actions.description:
The icon releases radiant energy and force pours from the icon’s body, which glows brightly as it does. Each creature within 30 feet of the icon (except its allies) must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 36 (8d8) radiant damage and be pushed back 10 feet. For 1 minute, any creature that hits the icon with a melee weapon attack from within 5 feet takes 5 (1d8) radiant damage, and they glow as though by their Illuminate feature with a 30-foot radius of bright light. Each time the icon takes damage while under this effect they must make a concentration check, ending the effect on a success.

Alternatively, instead of dealing the initial radiant damage, the icon can choose to have all its allies within 30 feet gain 36 (8d8) temporary hit points that disappear after 1 minute. The icon itself does not gain these temporary hit points.

bonus_actions.name: Gallop
bonus_actions.description: The icon increases its base movement speed by 40 feet until the start of its next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Illuminate
bonus_actions.description: The icon causes its body to glow as though by the light spell, granting soft light of a color it chooses in a radius centered on it, which can range from 5 to 20 feet, with another sphere of dim light extending twice as far. The icon can use this action again to adjust or dispel this light.
